my resume from hibernate seems fully reliable now. all i did was add

GRUB_GFXPAYLOAD_LINUX=keep

to my /etc/default/grub and change the line

GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="quiet splash"

to

GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT="quiet splash intel_pstate=disable"

it might be cargo cult troubleshooting to assume that this fixed my problem, and my sample size of hibernation cycles is too small to reach any definite conclusions, but i like to asume that the changes to grub fixed it (among a few other things) and i hope i didn't jinx it by posting this.
